Yes. The main n8n licence allows you to use it for your company's own internal workflows. It does
not allow reselling it or offering it to others as a service, and the enterprise (.ee) parts need a
paid licence. This answers the licence question only and is not an approval to adopt: security,
maintenance and privacy were not checked.

Follow-up
 • Will n8n ever be offered to customers, partners or other outside parties, or embedded in a
   product you sell?
 • Do you need enterprise features such as those in .ee files?

Why
 🟡 Licence: Internal business use is allowed; enterprise (.ee) files and resale or hosting for
   others are not.
   • Most of n8n is under the Sustainable Use License, which allows you to use and modify it for
     your own internal business purposes.
     "You may use or modify the software only for your own internal business purposes or for non-commercial or…" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L32-L33 ✔
   • You may not sell n8n or hand it to others, except free of charge for non-commercial purposes.
     Offering it to customers as a paid or hosted service is not covered.
     "You may distribute the software or provide it to others only if you do so free of charge for non-commercial…" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L33-L34 ✔
   • Files with .ee. in the name or in a .ee folder are not under the open licence. They need a paid
     n8n Enterprise licence for production use.
     "may only be used in production, if you (and any entity that you represent) hold a valid n8n Enterprise…" → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE_EE.md#L7-L9 ✔

What to do next
 1. Have legal confirm that your use counts as 'internal business purposes', including use across
   affiliated group companies (the licence's 'your company' covers controlled and related entities).
     Source: "You may distribute the software or provide it to others only if you do so free of
       charge…"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L33-L34
 2. Do not enable or use any .ee. files or enterprise-only features in production unless you buy an
   n8n Enterprise licence.
     Source: "may only be used in production, if you (and any entity that you represent) hold a
       valid…"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE_EE.md#L7-L9
 3. Keep the licence text with any copy you share inside the company, and mark any modified copy as
   modified.
     Source: "If you modify the software, you must include in any modified copies of the software
       a…"
     → https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/80bba6f89370a62eca88553ccf38a77c5e9d6d48/LICENSE.md#L50-L51
